name: Dumbbell Jump Squat
steps: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart, toes angled slightly out, holding a dumbbell beside each thigh.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees into a controlled quarter or half squat.
Drive explosively through both feet to jump straight upward while keeping your chest lifted.
Land softly on both feet, bending your hips and knees immediately to absorb the impact.
tips: Let the dumbbells hang calmly at your sides instead of swinging them.
Keep your knees aligned over your toes during both takeoff and landing.
